en: God’s love, the Lord’s tears, for all the world
The Lord who came to seek the lost souls still loves us even now.

ko: 이 천년 전 하늘 보좌 버리고
en: Leaving the throne of heaven two thousand years ago, He came to this earth
Becoming the Lamb of God, He gives life and tells us to bear witness to it

ko: 나는 믿네 거져 받은 귀한 사랑
en: I believe this precious love I received freely, who could ever take my place? Until the end of my life, I will proclaim that love
Until the end of my life,I will proclaim that love
